mapping.draft_py:
# Macabre Waltz: "Return up to two target creature cards from your graveyard to your hand, then
# discard a card."
# FDN Sanguine Indulgence's verified "Return up to two target creature cards from your graveyard to
# your hand." (B5b-return-cards-hand: QAtMost(2) TARGET), then the discard of "Draw a card, then
# discard a card." (B3-seq-draw-discard, M21 Obsessive Stitcher: a MOVE_ZONE of one card you choose
# from your hand to your graveyard).
ret = A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
    'cards': Selector(
        count=QAtMost(n=2),
        mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
    ),
    'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
})
discard = A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
    'cards': Selector(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
        filter=FAnd(children=()),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
    ),
    'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
    'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
    'from': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
})
abilities = [SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.SORCERY, effect=Seq(steps=(ret, discard)))]

clauses.clause: Return up to two target creature cards from your graveyard to your hand, then discard a card.

mapping.notes: FDN Sanguine Indulgence's verified return (QAtMost(2) TARGET creature cards in your graveyard), then B3-seq-draw-discard's discard (the canonicaliser makes it a ONE_OF over your hand, as Rain of Revelation's). Pack: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/macabre_waltz_returns_two_then_discards_one.json (two targets; the probe board has one creature card in the graveyard).
